collection: Ndovera WAEC Mathematics Structured Practice — Batch 002
note: 6 original multistep WAEC structured-response questions. Draft pending academic review; schema not yet verified compatible with Ndovera app. No D1 import.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.prompt: Given A=[[2,1],[5,3]], calculate det(A), find A⁻¹, and solve 2x+y=7 and 5x+3y=19 using the inverse matrix.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.prompt: The points A(−1,2), B(5,4), and C(3,−2) form a triangle. Calculate the area of triangle ABC and the midpoint of AC.
questions.answer: Area=16 square units; midpoint of AC=(1,0).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.prompt: The third and seventh terms of a geometric progression are 12 and 192 respectively. Given that the common ratio is positive, find the first term, common ratio and sum of the first six terms.
questions.answer: First term 3; common ratio 2; sum of first six terms 189.

markingGuide.description: ar²=12 and ar⁶=192; divide to obtain r⁴=16.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.prompt: The frequency table has scores 1, 2, 3, 4 with frequencies 2, 3, 4, 1. Find the mean, median, mode and population variance.

markingGuide.description: Ordered observations have fifth score 2 and sixth score 3, so median=2.5.
Score 3 has highest frequency 4, so mode=3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.prompt: From a point 30 m from the base of a vertical tower, the angle of elevation of its top is 30°. Find the height of the tower in exact form. If the observer moves 20 m closer, find the new angle of elevation to the nearest degree.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.prompt: A bag contains 5 red, 3 blue and 2 green counters. Two are drawn without replacement. Calculate (i) the probability of two different colours and (ii) the probability of at least one green.
questions.answer: Different colours=31/45; at least one green=17/45.

markingGuide.description: No green pairs=C(8,2)=28; at least one green=45−28=17, so P=17/45.
